notes: hook 2: two specific numbers in one line ($437,500 auction shoe vs a Rs 8,995 remake) over a clean, whole product shot: a real scroll-stopper. read 2: cover sets up the contrast, slide 2 explains why that pair was worth $437,500 (1 of 12, Bowerman, 1972 trials, only unworn pair, a record in 2019), slide 3 says where to buy the remake in India; no filler, nothing repeated from the cover. send 1 (the weak check): forwardable trivia plus an in-stock shoe, but it is not a new drop (on Indian shelves since Aug-Oct) and gives no deadline or scarcity, so the reason to send it to a specific person is moderate. keep 2: India price, two stores with sizes, style code IX3952-001 and the US price for comparison. reply 2: 'What's the oldest pair of sneakers you still wear?' is the only question, answered from readers' own lives. original 2: idly's own pairing of the 2019 auction with India availability, own design, Nike image credited on card and caption, sources on every text slide. alone 2: cover plus slides tell the whole story without the caption; record is dated and past tense.
